entries.label: Azura Back

tags.subject: Azura's-star medallion sigil, ringed border, lettered rim
tags.placement: high on the upper back, centered between the shoulder blades

entries.description: A small circular medallion bearing a many-pointed star at its center, ringed by a beaded border with archaic lettering or sigil-marks around the rim. Cardinal dots mark four compass points outside the ring, framing the central star like a planetary seal.

entries.label: Azura Chest

tags.subject: Azura's-star medallion sigil, ringed border, lettered rim
tags.placement: centered on the upper chest just below the collarbones

entries.description: The same compact celestial seal — a many-pointed star inside a beaded ring with sigil-marks around the rim — sized as a chest-piece between the breasts. Small cardinal dots flank the medallion at four compass points.

entries.label: Hermaeus Mora Back

tags.subject: eye-and-tentacle medallion, fringed appendages, ringed sigil
tags.placement: high on the upper back, centered between the shoulder blades

entries.description: A radial occult seal with a central pupil-iris eye nested inside a ringed border, surrounded by curling tentacle-like appendages that fan outward in every direction. Smaller eye-dots mark the perimeter, giving the medallion the feel of a many-eyed daedric icon.

entries.label: Hermaeus Mora Chest

tags.subject: eye-and-tentacle medallion, fringed appendages, ringed sigil
tags.placement: centered on the sternum between the breasts

entries.description: A compact chest-piece version of the many-eyed daedric medallion — a central pupil eye in a beaded ring, fringed by tentacle curls, with smaller dotted eyes around the perimeter. Sized to sit between the breasts.

entries.label: Sanguine Back

tags.subject: pentacle medallion, ornate border ornaments, ringed sigil
tags.placement: high on the upper back, centered between the shoulder blades

entries.description: A ringed pentacle medallion with the five-pointed star inscribed within a circle, framed by small ornamental clusters at the cardinal points. Inner detail suggests miniature sigils or lettering tucked into the negative space between the star arms.

entries.label: Sanguine Chest

tags.subject: rose-and-ornament sigil, low diamond silhouette, scrollwork wings
tags.placement: centered on the sternum between the breasts

entries.description: A small low-diamond ornament with a central rose-like flourish, flanked by short scrolling wings that taper outward symmetrically. The piece reads as a single delicate chest-medallion sitting between the breasts.

entries.label: Cat Skull Side L

tags.subject: scattered winged skull fragments, three small pieces
tags.placement: scattered along one side of the body — neck, ribs, and inner thigh

entries.description: Three small fragmented stencil shapes share the file: a tiny winged skull-like emblem near the collar, a partial winged mark on the side ribs, and a third winged emblem low near the inner thigh. The pieces appear designed as a coordinated scatter along one body side rather than a single anchored design.

entries.label: Snake Chest

tags.subject: coiled serpent silhouette, looped body, slim tail
tags.placement: centered on the upper chest just below the collarbones

entries.description: A coiled snake rendered in smooth black silhouette, its body looped through itself with a tapered tail trailing free. The piece sits low between the collarbones as a single compact emblem.

entries.label: Skull Chest

tags.subject: winged skull, scroll banner ornaments, central death's-head
tags.placement: centered on the sternum between the breasts

entries.description: A central skull crowned by spreading filigree wings or banner scrolls, mirroring outward to either side. Small ornamental flourishes hang below the skull, lending the silhouette the look of a memento-mori crest.

entries.label: Succubus Chest

tags.subject: winged succubus silhouette, horned head, splayed wings
tags.placement: centered on the sternum between the breasts

entries.description: A small horned demonic figure with wings spread wide to either side, body filled in solid black with curling tendril accents at the wing tips. The silhouette reads as a stylized succubus crest sitting between the breasts.

entries.label: Mehrunes Razor Thigh R

tags.subject: winged dagger silhouette, blade pointing down, scrollwork hilt
tags.style: filled silhouette with ornate hilt detail
tags.placement: on the outer side of the thigh near the hip

entries.description: A slender downward-pointing dagger with an ornate winged hilt, the blade tapering to a sharp tip and the cross-guard sprouting curling wing-like scrollwork. The piece sits as a vertical mark high on the outer thigh.

entries.label: Dragon Full Back

tags.subject: twin antler-branch dragons, splayed claws, central spine
tags.placement: spread across the upper back from shoulder to shoulder

entries.description: Two mirrored antler-like dragon forms rear up on either side of a central spine motif, their elongated branches splaying outward like clawed wings. A small triangular form anchors the centerline between them, giving the design the silhouette of a great spreading crest.

entries.id: BCT - Dragon Wings Back and Shoulders
entries.label: Dragon Wings Back and Shoulders

tags.subject: twin claw-fan wings, splayed tendril fingers, mirrored pair
tags.placement: across the upper back spanning both shoulder blades

entries.description: A mirrored pair of clawed wing-fans sweep outward from a central axis, each composed of several elongated tendril-fingers splaying away from a small bunched root. The pair reads as a spreading set of dragon wings across the upper back.

entries.label: Gem and Herbs Arm

tags.subject: horizontal sprig of herbs and a small set gemstone
tags.placement: on the inner side of the upper arm

entries.description: A small horizontal sprig of leafy herbs runs across the inner arm, with a single faceted gemstone nestled into the bundle. The piece reads as a delicate apothecary's mark, fine and slim.

entries.label: Rose Groin R

tags.subject: tiny cluster of small roses
tags.placement: low on the lower abdomen near one hip

entries.description: A very small cluster of three or four miniature rose buds with short curling stems, sized as a discreet accent rather than a large piece. Sits low on the abdomen above the pubic mound.

entries.label: Skull Groin

tags.subject: horned skull with scroll wings, central death's-head crest
tags.placement: centered low on the abdomen just above the pubic mound

entries.description: A central skull flanked by curling horn-and-scroll wings that sweep outward symmetrically. Smaller curling flourishes hang below the skull, framing it like a low-belly crest just above the pubic mound.

entries.label: Magick Inner Arm

tags.subject: twin slender sigil ornaments, one per inner arm
tags.placement: running along the inside of each upper arm

entries.description: A pair of slender mirrored sigil-shapes — fine curling glyphs with small star and bead accents — designed to sit along the inside of each upper arm. Each shape is delicate and elongated, reading more as a tally of arcane runes than a single dense piece.

entries.label: Moon Chest

tags.subject: small crescent moon with star ornament
tags.placement: centered on the upper chest just below the collarbones

entries.description: A small crescent moon cradles a tiny star-and-curl ornament at its inner hollow. The piece is sized as a delicate accent below the collarbones, more pendant than statement-piece.

entries.label: Moon Forearm

tags.subject: small curling star-and-moon glyph
tags.placement: on the inner side of the forearm

entries.description: A tiny twisted glyph combining a crescent and a small star, rendered as a delicate inner-forearm accent. Reads as a subtle astrological mark rather than a bold design.

entries.label: Moon Shoulder

tags.subject: small crescent moon with trailing curl
tags.placement: on the front of the shoulder near the collarbone

entries.description: A simple crescent moon with a small trailing curl off one tip, sized as a quiet accent at the front of the shoulder. Minimal and clean.

entries.label: Moth Underboob

tags.subject: ornate moth with detailed wings, slim body, antennae
tags.style: fine naturalistic linework with patterned wings
tags.placement: centered below the breasts on the sternum

entries.description: A symmetric moth with broad detailed wings spread to either side, the wing patterns finely textured and the slim body extending downward between them. A short trailing accent drops below, anchoring the moth to the underbreast space.

entries.label: Rose Arm L

tags.subject: single horizontal rose with stem
tags.style: filled silhouette with fine stem detail
tags.placement: along the inner side of the forearm

entries.description: A single rose in full bloom is rendered horizontally with a long thin stem trailing to one side, sized to lie along the inner forearm. The bloom is filled in solid black with delicate stem detail.

entries.label: Rose Side L

tags.subject: paired rose cluster fragments, two anchor points
tags.placement: scattered along the side of the torso and lower belly

entries.description: Two small rose-and-vine cluster fragments sit on the same body side — one anchored higher near the ribs/upper arm, the other lower near the hip and outer abdomen. The pieces read as a coordinated trail rather than a single contiguous design.

entries.label: Snake Arm R

tags.subject: coiled serpent silhouette, raised head
tags.placement: wrapped along the side of the torso between rib and arm

entries.description: A coiled snake rendered in smooth black silhouette, body looped and raised head turned outward. The piece is sized to sit along the lateral torso just below the underarm.

entries.label: Skull Underboob

tags.subject: winged skull, slim body, wing-fan ornaments
tags.placement: centered below the breasts on the sternum

entries.description: A small central skull is framed by a pair of long thin wing-fans that sweep horizontally to either side. A short trailing accent drops below, giving the piece the proportions of a delicate sternum-mounted crest.

entries.label: Wolf Leg L

tags.subject: horned wolf head, fanged maw, detailed mane
tags.style: filled silhouette with shaggy mane detail
tags.placement: on the outer side of the thigh

entries.description: A snarling horned wolf head fills a vertical patch, its mouth open showing fangs and the mane rendered in rough textured strokes around the crown. Stylized horns curl back over the skull, lending the silhouette a daedric look.

entries.label: Wolf Leg R

tags.subject: horned wolf head, fanged maw, detailed mane
tags.style: filled silhouette with shaggy mane detail
tags.placement: on the outer side of the thigh

entries.description: The same horned wolf head — snarling jaws, curled horns, shaggy textured mane — sized as a thigh patch. Used as the partner piece to its mirrored sibling for symmetric placement.

entries.label: Wolf Side R

tags.subject: wolf head set, three pieces, scattered along one side
tags.style: filled silhouette with shaggy mane detail
tags.placement: wrapping one body side from collar to hip

entries.description: Three wolf-head fragments share the file: one small head near the collar, a larger head on the side of the ribs, and a third on the outer hip. Together they form a scattered single-side trail rather than a single anchored piece.

entries.label: Succubus Womb  1

tags.subject: thin ornate band with central crest
tags.placement: low on the abdomen just above the pubic mound

entries.description: A slim horizontal band of ornate filigree rests above the pubic mound, with a small central crest or pendant detail at the midline. Reads as a delicate belt-band of decoration rather than a large figural piece.

entries.label: uccubus Womb  2

tags.subject: downward triangular pendant, filigree interior, pointed tip
tags.placement: centered low on the abdomen just above the pubic mound

entries.description: A downward-pointing triangular ornament with intricate filigree filling its interior, its lower point aimed at the pubic mound. The shape suggests a stylized pendant or arrowhead crest centered on the lower belly.

entries.label: Succubus Womb  3

tags.subject: winged heart ornament, scroll wings, central heart
tags.placement: centered low on the abdomen just above the pubic mound

entries.description: A small central heart framed by curling scroll-wings that sweep outward symmetrically, the silhouette suggesting a heraldic winged-heart pendant. Sits just above the pubic mound as a delicate accent piece.
